title: BriefingsFile
description: `briefings.yaml`: the crew briefings and their mnemonics, which Practice asks about.

BriefItem.description: One line of a briefing: the letter of its mnemonic and the rest of the word.

detail.description: What to cover under this line.

id.description: Unique in the pack. Saved progress uses it, so it never changes once published.

lead.description:
The letters of the mnemonic this line stands for, e.g. `R`; with `rest` it makes the
line's word as Practice shows it.

rest.description: The rest of the word after `lead`, e.g. `unway`.

Briefing.description:
A crew briefing for one phase. The app doesn't show briefings yet; Practice asks about a
briefing's mnemonic and its items.

mnemonic.description:
The word its lines' letters spell. Practice asks about briefings that have one, and
leaves out one whose mnemonic is empty.

phase.description: The phase it belongs to, which must exist; Practice links to it.

title.description: Its name, e.g. `Departure`: Practice calls it "the Departure briefing".
